title: andrewyng/aisuite
description: Simple, unified interface to multiple Generative AI providers OpenCoworker An AI agent that lives on your desktop, built on aisuite. OpenCoworker is a desktop AI agent that can not only chat, but also do deep research and carry out tasks for you on your computer. It can read files (with permission) to gain context, read/send messages (slack, email, etc.), and create real deliverables like PDF reports, documents, spreadsheets. It also supports scheduled automations, such as providing you a daily news summary. Requires bringing your own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) or run fully local with Ollama. Your data stays on your machine. ⬇ Download for macOS   macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon)    ⬇ Download for Windows   Windows 10/11 (x64)  ·  Quickstart: — install, connect a model, first tasks, automations. Its source lives in this repository under platform/ — a working reference for building your own agent harness on aisuite. aisuite aisuite is a lightweight Python library for building with LLMs, in two layers: a unified Chat Completions API across providers, and an Agents API with tools and toolkits on top. This repo is also home to OpenCoworker, a desktop AI coworker built using aisuite: ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ OpenCoworker │ agent harness for doing everyday tasks ├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Agents API · Toolkits · MCP │ build agents across multiple LLMs ├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Chat Completions API │ one API across multiple LLM providers ├────────┬───────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┤ │ OpenAI │ Anthropic │ Google │ Ollama │ Others │ └────────┴───────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┘ Chat Completions API — a unified, OpenAI-style interface for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Hugging Face, AWS, Cohere, Ollama, OpenRouter, and more. Swap providers by changing one string. Agents API · Toolkits · MCP — give models real Python functions as tools, run multi-turn loops, attach ready-made toolkits (files, git, shell) or any MCP server, and govern it all with tool policies. OpenCoworker — a desktop AI coworker built using aisuite, shipped as an app for everyday tasks. Installation The aisuite library (Python) Install the base package, or include the SDKs of the providers you plan to use: pip install aisuite # base package, no provider SDKs pip install 'aisuite[anthropic]' # with a specific provider's SDK pip install 'aisuite[all]' # with all provider SDKs You'll also need API keys for the providers you call — the Chat Completions quickstart covers key setup and your first calls. The OpenCoworker app (desktop) Download the installer and bring your own API key (or run local models with Ollama): ⬇ macOS (Apple Silicon)  ·  ⬇ Windows 10/11 (x64)  ·  OpenCoworker quickstart Chat Completions — one API across providers The chat API provides a high-level abstraction for model interactions. It supports all core parameters (temperature, max_tokens, tools, etc.) in a provider-agnostic way, and standardizes request and response structures so you can focus on logic rather than SDK differences. Model names use the format <provider>:<model-name>; aisuite routes the call to the right provider with the right parameters: import aisuite as ai client = ai.Client() models = ["openai:gpt-4o", "anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"] messages = [ {"role": "system", "content": "Respond in Pirate English."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a joke."}, ] for model in models: response = client.chat.completions.create( model=model, messages=messages, temperature=0.75 ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) → Quickstart: docs/chat-completions-quickstart.md — install, key setup, local models, and more examples. Agents — give models real tools aisuite turns tool calling into a one-liner: pass plain Python functions and it generates the schemas, executes the calls, and feeds results back to the model. Tool calling with max_turns def will_it_rain(location: str, time_of_day: str): """Check if it will rain in a location at a given time today. Args: location (str): Name of the city time_of_day (str): Time of the day in HH:MM format. """ return "YES" client = ai.Client() response = client.chat.completions.create( model="openai:gpt-4o", messages=[{ "role": "user", "content": "I live in San Francisco. Can you check for weather " "and plan an outdoor picnic for me at 2pm?" }], tools=[will_it_rain], max_turns=2 # Maximum number of back-and-forth tool calls ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) With max_turns set, aisuite sends your message, executes any tool calls the model requests, returns the results to the model, and repeats until the conversation completes. response.choices[0].intermediate_messages carries the full tool interaction history if you want to continue the conversation. Prefer full manual control? Omit max_turns and pass OpenAI-format JSON tool specs — aisuite returns the model's tool-call requests and you run the loop yourself. See examples/tool_calling_abstraction.ipynb for both styles. The Agents API For longer-running, structured work there is a first-class Agents API: declare an agent once, run it with a Runner, and attach toolkits — prebuilt, sandboxed tool families for files, git, and shell: import aisuite as ai from aisuite import Agent, Runner agent = Agent( name="repo-helper", model="anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6", instructions="You are a careful repo assistant. Use your tools to answer from the code.", tools=[*ai.toolkits.files(root="."), *ai.toolkits.git(root=".")], ) result = Runner.run(agent, "What changed in the last commit? Summarize in 3 bullets.") print(result.final_output) The Agents API also gives you the pieces a production harness needs: Tool policies — RequireApprovalPolicy, allow/deny lists, or your own callable deciding which tool calls run. State stores — persist and resume runs (in-memory, file, or Postgres) and continue conversations across processes. Artifacts & tracing — capture what an agent produced and every step it took along the way. MCP tools aisuite natively supports the Model Context Protocol, so any MCP server's tools can be handed to a model without boilerplate (pip install 'aisuite[mcp]'): client = ai.Client() response = client.chat.completions.create( model="openai:gpt-4o", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "List the files in the current directory"}], tools=[{ "type": "mcp", "name": "filesystem", "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path/to/directory"] }], max_turns=3 ) print(response.choices[0].message.content) For reusable connections, security filters, and tool prefixing, use the explicit MCPClient. → Quickstart: docs/agents-quickstart.md — manual tool handling, the full Agents API, policies, state stores, and MCP in depth. Extending aisuite: Adding a Provider New providers can be added by implementing a lightweight adapter. The system uses a naming convention for discovery: Element Convention Module file <provider>_provider.py Class name <Provider>Provider (capitalized) Example: # providers/openai_provider.py class OpenaiProvider(BaseProvider): ... This convention ensures consistency and enables automatic loading of new integrations. Contributing Contributions are welcome. Please review the Contributing Guide and join our Discord for discussions. License Released under the MIT License — free for commercial and non-commercial use.
tldr: Andrew Ng 发布 aisuite，一个轻量级 Python 库，提供统一的 Chat Completions API 和 Agents API，支持多 LLM 提供商切换和工具调用；同时发布基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 助手 OpenCoworker。
objective_summary: Andrew Ng 团队在 GitHub 上发布 aisuite 项目，该项目包含两层架构：底层是统一 Chat Completions API，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Mistral 等多家 LLM 提供商通过单字符串切换；上层是 Agents API，提供工具调用、工具包（文件、Git、Shell）、MCP 协议支持及策略管理功能。同时基于 aisuite 构建了桌面 AI 助手 OpenCoworker，支持聊天、深度研究、文件读写、消息收发和日程自动化。用户需自带 API 密钥或通过 Ollama 本地运行。
key_logic_flow: aisuite 提供统一的 Chat Completions API，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Mistral 等多家提供商，模型名使用 <provider>:<model-name> 格式即可切换。
aisuite 的 Agents API 支持将普通 Python 函数作为工具传入模型，自动生成 schema 并执行多轮调用，同时提供预构建工具包（文件、Git、Shell）和 MCP 协议原生支持。
Agents API 还提供工具策略管理（RequireApprovalPolicy、允许/拒绝列表）、状态存储（内存、文件或 Postgres）以及制品追踪能力。
OpenCoworker 是基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 助手，支持聊天、深度研究、文件操作、消息收发（Slack、邮件）和日程自动化，数据保留在本地。
新提供商可通过实现轻量级适配器（<provider>_provider.py 文件和 <Provider>Provider 类）接入，系统按命名约定自动发现和加载。
项目采用 MIT 许可证，支持商业和非商业用途，欢迎社区贡献。

object_mentions.name: OpenCoworker
evidence_snippets: OpenCoworker 是基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 助手，可以聊天、深度研究并在用户电脑上执行任务。
OpenCoworker 支持文件读写、收发 Slack 和邮件消息、生成 PDF 报告和电子表格等实际交付物。
OpenCoworker 支持定时自动化，例如每日新闻摘要，需要用户自带 API 密钥或通过 Ollama 本地运行。

impact_score.reason: Andrew Ng 的品牌效应会为 aisuite 带来远超同类项目（如 LiteLLM）的关注度和采用率。统一的多模型 API 在拥挤赛道中并非原创，但 MIT 许可证+轻量级设计+Agents API（工具包、MCP 支持）的组合降低了切换成本和入门门槛。OpenCoworker 桌面端作为落地参考实现，展示了从 API 到应用的全栈能力，可能推动更多开发者尝试本地 AI 助手方案。综合来看，这是一次重要的产品级发布，会改变局部竞争格局（尤其与 LangChain/LiteLLM 的对比），但尚未达到范式转移级别。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 通过 <provider>:<model-name> 一行代码切换模型，统一 API 降低多厂商集成成本

hype_assessment.reason: 项目文档提供了完整的技术细节、API 签名、安装命令和代码示例，没有使用'颠覆'、'革命性'等放大的 PR 词汇。Andrew Ng 团队的发布风格偏技术务实，功能边界清晰（适配器模式、MIT 协议、自带 API Key），没有过度承诺。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 通过 <provider>_provider.py 文件名 + <Provider>Provider 类名的命名约定实现新提供商自动发现和注册，避免了传统工厂模式或注册表的复杂性。Agents API 将 Python 函数自动转为工具 schema 并支持 max_turns 自动循环，降低了工具调用编程门槛。MCP 协议的原生集成让任意 MCP 服务器的工具可直接注入 agent，打通了外部工具生态。
domain_disruption.business_model: MIT 许可证完全开放，不锁定用户到任何云服务或平台。用户自带 API Key 的模式消除了数据隐私顾虑。OpenCoworker 桌面端作为分发渠道，可能复制 VS Code 的生态路径——核心库免费开源，通过桌面应用建立用户习惯和生态锁定。

compound_value.reason: aisuite 的核心价值在于 Andrew Ng 品牌背书+极简 API 设计+原生 MCP 支持的三重组合。统一 Chat Completions API 层本身趋于商品化（LiteLLM 等对标项目众多），但 Agents API 层的 Toolkits（文件/Git/Shell）、工具策略（RequireApprovalPolicy）、状态持久化和制品追踪构成了差异化能力，参考实现 OpenCoworker 也验证了落地场景。MIT 许可证+BYOK 模式有利于企业采用，但也意味着变现路径不清晰。真正复利来自：(1) MCP 协议的原生深度绑定——有望成为 Agent 工具链的事实标准入口，形成生态锁定；(2) DeepLearning.AI 社区的分发优势可带来持续的用户增长。主要风险：大模型厂商加速统一 API 标准（OpenAI 兼容接口成为事实规范，削弱抽象层价值），以及 LangChain/LiteLLM 跟进 MCP 后差异化缩小。当前评分反映'细分赛道潜力标的但尚需验证规模化拐点'的判断，建议观察 6-12 个月生态采纳率和企业级付费转化后再判断是否升级。

key_beneficiaries: 中小型 AI 应用开发者
competitive_casualty: 单一模型锁定的 Agent 工具链
market_opportunities: 开发者可利用 aisuite 的统一 Chat Completions API 快速构建跨模型应用，以一行代码切换提供商，显著降低模型供应商锁定风险并灵活平衡成本与性能
OpenCoworker 桌面 Agent 模式验证了本地优先 AI 助手的可行产品形态，适合面向知识工作者构建垂直场景（如文档自动化、日常信息聚合、定时报告生成）的轻量级工具
aisuite 的 Agents API 与 MCP 原生集成为企业级 AI Agent 编排提供了标准化底座，可围绕其开发安全审计、工具策略管控、多步工作流编排等中间件服务

risk_matrix.regulatory: 桌面 Agent 自动读写本地文件、收发邮件和 Slack 消息的能力，在欧盟 AI Act 框架下可能被归类为高风险自动化系统；用户需自行承担 API 使用合规责任，企业部署需额外审查数据保护与行业监管要求
risk_matrix.technological: aisuite 作为多模型抽象层，高度依赖各提供商 API 的稳定性与向后兼容性；提供商 SDK 变更或 API 退役可能导致集成断裂；Ollama 本地模型在复杂推理任务中能力可能持续落后于云端旗舰模型；MCP 协议仍在演进，接口可能非稳定
risk_matrix.competitive: 该赛道已有 LangChain、LiteLLM、Semantic Kernel、Vercel AI SDK 等成熟竞品，aisuite 虽获得 Andrew Ng 品牌背书，但缺乏差异化商业护城河，在模型抽象层面临价格战和生态挤压风险
risk_matrix.ethical: OpenCoworker 的文件读写和通信功能即使经用户授权，仍存在隐私泄露和敏感信息意外暴露的风险；自动化 Shell/Git 工具调用在提示注入攻击下可能对本地系统造成实质性损害；桌面 Agent 的自动化能力可能加速知识工作者的就业结构冲击
additional: 桌面端 Agent 的权限模型安全性需持续关注——若被植入恶意 MCP 服务器或工具包，可导致本地数据泄露或未授权操作；多提供商 API Key 集中管理增加密钥泄露面

object_insights.name: andrewyng/aisuite

object_insights.technical_signal: 项目采用两层架构设计：底层 Chat Completions API 以单一抽象层统一多家 LLM 接口差异；上层 Agents API 提供工具调用、MCP 协议原生支持和策略管理能力。
object_insights.adoption_signal: 项目采用 MIT 许可证，Andrew Ng 的品牌影响力有助于吸引社区贡献者，同时降低企业采用的法律顾虑。
object_insights.ecosystem_relevance: aisuite 原生支持 MCP 协议，可无缝对接任意 MCP 服务器的工具，是连接 LLM 与外部工具生态的关键桥梁。
